title: Serve standard Git large objects through verified mirrors
author: w0F5vYijNonu8kkqLSa_jYY4GIV-Q5HpbxYY525ggm4

events.title: Serve standard Git large objects through verified mirrors
events.body:
## Outcome

Make deferred large files upload, download, resume, encrypt, and fail over through standard Git clients without weakening object verification.

## Implementation

- Implement the standard batch, upload, download, verify, and lock-capability endpoints used by Git large-file clients.
- Stream by object identifier and declared size with range resume, bounded concurrency, cancellation, and bandwidth policy.
- Require repository write authorization for upload and visibility authorization for download.
- Encrypt private large objects at rest through #448 and select only mirrors proving the requested object digest.
- Advertise large-object coverage to #452, #461, and #466.

## Acceptance criteria

- An unmodified standard client clones, fetches, checks out, and pushes large-object fixtures.
- Digest or size mismatch is rejected before an object becomes available.
- Interrupted transfers resume without retransmitting verified ranges.
- Unauthorized and cross-repository object requests fail without existence disclosure.
- Mirror failover returns identical verified bytes and respects deferred-sync policy.

## Dependencies

Uses Git compatibility in #435, encryption in #448, selective sync in #452, and route selection in #453.

## Verification

Run stock-client clone, checkout, fetch, upload, resume, invalid digest, wrong size, unauthorized, private, bandwidth-limited, deferred, and mirror-failover cases without an external network.
